mission.title: Ананія
learning_objectives: Retrieve explicit Paul/Acts propositions at passage level.
Link claims to machine-validatable reusable evidence.
Preserve narrator, embedded speech, later defense speech, and epistolary autobiography provenance.
Reject unsupported harmonization and accept not-stated boundaries.
Complete keyboard/NVDA-equivalent evidence, ordering, matching and synthesis tasks.
mission.future_repetition_hooks: Concrete RESOLVED_NODE/REVIEW_QUEUE/DEFERRED_CAMPAIGN targets are stored per node.
mission.source_classification_notes: Acts 9 narrator and Paul's Acts 22/26 speeches remain distinct; omission of Ananias in Acts 26 is not denial.
disputed_points: Do not force the three commission placements into one verbatim transcript.
mission.textual_variant_points: none material to grading in this lane
mission.opening_brief: Investigate Ананія through source-labelled Acts/Pauline evidence without flattening witnesses.
mission.case_question: What does the assigned corpus establish about Ананія, and what must remain source-bounded?
known_facts_at_start: PA-01 and PA-02 remain prior campaign context; retrieval never changes their confidence/provenance.
mission.completion_synthesis: Source-cited reconstruction that preserves local witness voice, confidence, TX1 status and uncertainty.
mission.failure_recovery_routes: Every partial/incorrect branch returns to the current node after targeted feedback/evidence review; no dead ends.
mission.completion_conditions: Complete 53 required nodes independently or through guided H7 routes; evidence refs must resolve.
mission.perfect_investigation_conditions: Independent completion of final synthesis and evidence tasks with no H7 reveal; knowledge-performance only.

accessibility.screen_reader_announcement_requirements: Announce node heading, source scope, result, evidence/confidence/TX1 qualification, mastery consequence and next action.
accessibility.nonvisual_equivalent: Every task is a labelled linear form. Ordering uses move up/down; matching uses paired selects; evidence uses labelled text cards; long/composite tasks use ordered editors.
accessibility.focus_order: Heading → source → task controls → submit → textual feedback → next action.

mission.runtime_compatibility: Canonical task types preserved; current DEV5 fallback adapter supplied for pre-integration-unsupported structured comparison types.
